description: FIND-011's core defeat (test touching the real prod log path) is genuinely fixed: loop.sh:15 now reads `LP="${LMCAP_LOGFILE:-$HOME/.openclaw/.../daily_loop.log}"` and test-loop.sh's run() always passes `LMCAP_LOGFILE="$LOG"` pointing at a per-test tempfile, so the real production log is never opened or touched by the test suite. Test E (test-loop.sh:19) exercises the STALE branch (age=5d -> CAPAFY-LOOP-STALE + selfheal-request written) with a real assertion. However, the OTHER heal branch on the same line of code — `CAPAFY-LOOP-NEVER-RAN` (loop.sh:74, the `else` when the file does not exist at all) — has zero test coverage: run()'s helper always does `touch "$LOG"` unconditionally (test-loop.sh:9) before optionally backdating its mtime, so the file always exists in every test case; no test ever passes a log path that doesn't exist. This is a real, currently-untested code path (distinct wording/heal message from STALE) that a future refactor could silently break without any test failing.

evidence.snippet:
touch "$LOG"; [ "${5:-0}" -gt 0 ] && touch -t "..." "$LOG"
... echo "E: STALE publish log (5d) ..."; O="$(run ... 5)"; a "stale->heal" ... 'CAPAFY-LOOP-STALE' ...
# no test ever calls run() with a $LOG path that is never created

evidence2.snippet:
if [ -f "$LP" ]; then
  AGE=...
  [ "$AGE" -le 2 ] || add_heal "CAPAFY-LOOP-STALE(${AGE}d) ..."
else add_heal "CAPAFY-LOOP-NEVER-RAN -> wire+fire daily_loop.sh"; fi

fix: Add a test G: run() with a LOG path that is never touched/created (or extend run() to accept a sentinel like age=-1 meaning 'do not create the file') and assert heal_first contains 'CAPAFY-LOOP-NEVER-RAN'.
